author: GamingBolt
description:
Captain Tsubasa 2 is, overall, an uneven sequel. On one hand, it does offer solid, enjoyable on-pitch football gameplay, and improves on the bombastic, high octane offerings of its predecessor in some minor yet notable ways. 

At the same time, it’s a game that just keeps getting in its own way, whether that is with its excessive focus on a thoroughly unenjoyable story and set of characters, or with its dearth of content offerings outside of an inconsistent story mode. For an iterative sequel, Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters isn’t very iterative, and falls in a lot of the same traps that its predecessor did.
title: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Amid all the showcases of the past several weeks, leave it to Nintendo to deliver one of the biggest impacts in gaming. The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake finally received a proper reveal, and immediately galvanised its fair share of viewers. Fans' reactions ranged from excited to shocked – some were outright indignant at the visual overhaul, calling it either AI slop or DLSS 5 (and no, I don't know how that would work either).

Of course, the release date was also announced: November 5th. And it caused another flurry of discussion, because as everyone and their immediate family is probably aware, Grand Theft Auto 6 launches in the same month.
title: Did Nintendo Just Put The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake In GTA 6’s Blast Radius?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Control Resonant represents a substantial evolution in Remedy’s supernatural universe. Taking the fight to a warped Manhattan, with a paranatural arsenal that includes a shapeshifting weapon, Control’s sequel is changing almost every layer of the formula. 

Here are 15 things you need to know before you buy.
title: Control Resonant - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
